## About [Jobsity](https://www.jobsity.com/)💡
Jobsity is a New York–based staffing company with 10+ years of experience, working with clients across the US, Canada, and Europe. We connect top-tier LATAM talent—only the top 3%—with long-term international opportunities and have successfully placed over 400 professionals across 15+ countries. As part of our recruitment process, we focus on finding the right role based on what matters most to you.

## Requirements

𝗪̳𝗵̳𝗮̳𝘁̳ ̳𝗱̳𝗼̳ ̳𝘆̳𝗼̳𝘂̳ ̳𝗻̳𝗲̳𝗲̳𝗱̳ ̳𝘁̳𝗼̳ ̳𝗮̳𝗽̳𝗽̳𝗹̳𝘆̳ ̳𝘀̳𝘂̳𝗰̳𝗰̳𝗲̳𝘀̳𝘀̳𝗳̳𝘂̳𝗹̳𝗹̳𝘆̳?🥇
🌟 A minimum of +B2 level Conversational English level
🌟 Must reside in Latin America🌎
🌟 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, with Python as the primary language, including production software running on hardware in the field.
🌟 Experience building and deploying software on embedded Linux computing platforms such as NVIDIA Jetson or comparable single-board computers and system-on-modules.
🌟 Hands-on Docker experience packaging, versioning and deploying containerized applications.
🌟 Experience working with message brokers, specifically MQTT and Kafka (or similar like RabbitMQ).
🌟Experience implementing or configuring Linux drivers for external peripherals and imaging hardware such as cameras.

## Modality
👨‍💻 Fully remote

## Perks that Jobsity offers!💎

🔹Yearly paid vacation.
🔹Paid local holidays.
🔹Learning budget.
🔹Financing program for home office supplies.
🔹Bonuses for referrals and more!

## Type of contract📜

This role is full-time!🕘
...working remotely🏡, with USD payment💰, long-term relationship🤝, within an international team👩‍💻 👨‍💻, and working on international client projects!🌎

## How to apply🤔
✔️ Send an email to angela.barboza@jobsity.com with your CV and LinkedIn attached

✔️ Or just send me a DM!

## How to refer a friend🤔
✔️ Refer a friend👥 sending an email with your friend's CV and LinkedIn attached
✔️ Or just send me a DM!

## Any questions or additional details needed?
Feel free to send me a message on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/angela-barboza/)💬

items.title: [HYBRID] SENIOR/ STAFF SOFTWARE ENGINEER (PYTHON) - PRODUCT COMPANY - OPEN SALARY
items.description:
**About the role**

- As a Senior Software Engineer at Inspectorio, you will partner with Product, Design, QA, and Customer Support to solve complex business problems and deliver customer value. You will use modern engineering practices, including AI-assisted development where appropriate, while maintaining high standards for architecture, quality, security, and operational excellence. As such, we are open to hiring a Senior Software Engineer with either strong backend expertise in Python, or fullstack experience with a frontend focus in Angular alongside Python.
- Success in this role is defined not only by technical implementation, but by the ability to frame problems effectively, evaluate trade-offs, orchestrate solutions across systems and teams, and guide projects from concept to measurable business outcomes.

**What you'll do**

- Design, develop, and maintain high-performance backend services using Python and Django. 
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including designers, product managers, and other engineers, to deliver high-quality software solutions. 
- Lead problem discovery, root cause analysis, and solution framing for complex technical and business challenges.
- Translate ambiguous business requirements into well-defined technical solutions and execution plans.
- Drive decisions through data, experimentation, and rapid prototyping.
- Work closely with Customer Support and QA teams to investigate and resolve customer-reported incidents, bugs, and requests in a timely and professional manner. 
- Demonstrate strong communication and collaboration skills, participating actively in team discussions, planning sessions, and retrospectives. 
- Architect and implement new features and services that meet business requirements. 
- Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code adhering to best practices and industry standards. 
- Lead code reviews, provide constructive feedback, and mentor junior developers to enhance the team’s capabilities. 
- Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve performance bottlenecks and other backend issues. 
- Stay current with the latest industry trends, technologies, and best practices, particularly in Python and Django. 
- Optimize applications for maximum speed and scalability while ensuring security and data protection standards. 
- Contribute to the improvement of the development process, including continuous integration and deployment strategies.

**Qualifications**

- 5+ years of professional experience in backend development, with a strong emphasis on Python and Django. 
- Deep understanding of object-oriented programming, design patterns, and other OOP principles such as SOLID and GRASP. 
- Experience with RESTful APIs, API-first approach, and microservices architecture. 
- Proficient in working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, or similar. 
- Demonstrated ability to solve ambiguous problems and translate business objectives into scalable technical solutions.
- Strong systems-thinking mindset with the ability to reason across product, technical, operational, and customer domains.
- Experience using AI-assisted development tools responsibly to improve engineering productivity, including coding, testing, debugging, documentation, and solution design, while maintaining high standards for quality, security, and maintainability.
- Proven ability to evaluate competing solutions and make sound trade-off decisions under uncertainty.
- Excellent written communication skills, including the ability to produce high-quality technical designs, implementation plans, and architectural proposals.
- Experience with asynchronous programming and related frameworks like Celery. 
- Proficient with version control systems, particularly Git. 
- Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and their services. 
- Proven ability to work independently and within cross-functional teams. 
- Understanding of CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and container orchestration tools like Kubernetes 
- Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment. 
- Great communication skills, in English, both written and verbal. 

**NICE TO HAVE**

- Experience with Angular (v18+) and modern frontend development. 
- Ability to contribute across the fullstack (backend + frontend). 

**Benefits**
- Full salary insurance
- Premium healthcare PVI for employees & children 
- Lunch allowance, well-being allowance, team building, tet holiday,..
- Unlimited days leave
- Hyrbrid working environment

items.description:
**About the role**

- The Core Services team supports complex workflows, integrations, and data-driven decision-making, requiring a strong focus on reliability, scalability, performance, and user experience. Its core functionalities include Organization & User Management, Authentication & Authorization, and Billing & Subscription Management.
- As a Senior QA Engineer, you will play a key role in advancing quality engineering practices across the Core Services solutions area. You will design and scale test automation frameworks, improve product testability, and partner closely with Product and Engineering teams to ensure high-quality releases. 
- This role requires strong technical expertise, a quality-first mindset, and the ability to influence engineering decisions through collaboration, data-driven insights, and modern automation practices. You will help drive the adoption of scalable quality engineering approaches, mentor other QA engineers, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across the engineering organization.

**What you'll do**

- Drive Quality Excellence: Contribute to the evolution of QA and quality engineering practices within the organization. Identify opportunities to improve testing effectiveness, release reliability, and development efficiency through automation, process improvements, and better quality visibility. 
- Leverage AI-Enhanced Quality Engineering: Evaluate and adopt AI-assisted tools and practices that improve test design, automation development, defect analysis, and engineering productivity. Contribute to initiatives that increase testing efficiency while maintaining engineering rigor and quality standards. 
- Partner Across Teams: Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, and Engineers to influence feature design, acceptance criteria, and implementation decisions that improve testability and product quality. 
- Promote Shift-Left Quality Practices: Engage early in the software development lifecycle by collaborating closely with Product Managers, Designers, and Engineers to influence feature design, acceptance criteria, and implementation decisions that improve testability and product quality. 
- Ensure Comprehensive Test Coverage: Develop and implement test strategies that balance automated and exploratory approaches across regression, integration, end-to-end, performance, and reliability testing. 
- Improve Quality Outcomes: Drive measurable improvements in automation coverage, regression execution efficiency, defect prevention, release confidence, and overall product quality. 
- Lead Incident and Defect Management: Investigate complex defects, perform root-cause analysis, and provide actionable insights to engineering teams. Partner with stakeholders to prioritize and resolve quality issues efficiently.  

**Qualifications**
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
- 5+ years of experience in software quality engineering, including extensive experience building and maintaining automated testing solutions.
- 3+ years of hands-on experience in test automation development.
- Strong proficiency in JavaScript and/or TypeScript with solid software engineering fundamentals.
- Proven ability to collaborate effectively across Product, Engineering, and DevOps teams.
- Strong expertise in API testing, frontend UI automation, and end-to-end testing strategies.
- Experience with SQL and relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL), including writing complex queries (joins, subqueries, aggregations) for data validation, test data preparation, and defect investigation.
- Strong understanding of software architecture and how system components interact.
- Deep knowledge of test design techniques, test architecture, defect lifecycle management, and quality engineering best practices.
- Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
- Strong verbal and written communication skills in English.

**Preferred Qualifications**

- Experience leveraging AI-assisted engineering tools to improve test automation, test design, defect analysis, or developer productivity.
- Experience implementing AI-driven quality engineering workflows and automation solutions.
- Experience testing distributed systems, microservices architectures, and event-driven applications.
- Understanding of modern quality engineering practices including:
- Shift-left testing
- Contract testing
- CI/CD quality gates
- Risk-based testing
- Observability-driven testing
- Experience defining, measuring, and improving quality metrics such as:
- Automation coverage
- Defect escape rate
- Release health
- Test effectiveness
- Mean time to resolution (MTTR)
- Experience working in high-growth SaaS environments and supporting large-scale customer-facing platforms.

**Benefits**:
- Full salary insurance
- Premium healthcare PVI for employees & children 
- Lunch allowance, well-being allowance, team building, tet holiday,..
- Unlimited days leave
- Hyrbrid working environment

items.title: [Remoto] Engenheiro(a) de Software Sênior – Code Quality (Python, JS/TS, Java, Go) - Turing (via AYAN)
items.description:
## Nossa empresa

A AYAN é parceira oficial da Turing, empresa que conecta profissionais técnicos aos principais laboratórios de IA do mundo. Estamos selecionando engenheiros(as) de software sênior para revisar e melhorar código gerado por IA em modelos de fronteira. Não é vaga de tester nem de QA manual.

## Descrição da vaga

Você vai avaliar código gerado por IA quanto a correção, segurança, escalabilidade e manutenibilidade, encontrar bugs e fragilidades de arquitetura, escrever soluções de referência de alta qualidade e criar as rubricas usadas para treinar e avaliar LLMs.

## Local

100% remoto. Aberta para quem mora no Brasil (também aceita Colômbia, Bangladesh, Índia, Paquistão, Indonésia, Egito, Gana, Nigéria e Turquia).

items.title: Add an "Updated At" timestamp column so readers can spot new roles
items.description:
The `Date Posted` column is day-level only, so when new roles get added between refreshes there's no way to tell which rows are new since my last visit — I have to re-scan the whole table from the top and remember where I left off.

Proposal: add a column (e.g. `Updated At`) showing the date + time each row was added or updated by the bot, like:

| Company | Job Title | Location | Date Posted | Updated At |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Company A | ... | ... | Sep 29 | Sep 29, 13:53 |
| Company B | ... | ... | Sep 29 | Sep 29, 17:54 |

This should be feasible since the bot already knows when it inserts each row (the timestamp is implicit in the commit history today) — persisting it per-row just makes it visible to everyone. Readers could then instantly see what's new since their last refresh.
